---
title: "Tax Cuts Cause Recessions!"
date: "2008-02-09"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

If you think tax cuts lead to higher interest rates, then I guess it follows that you would also believe that tax cuts cause recessions.  From [someone](http://www.businessspectator.com.au/bs.nsf/Article/Rudds-tax-cut-aspirations-BMRZ5?OpenDocument "someone") who should know better:

> *This is no joke: Kevin Rudd’s tax cuts will increase the risk of a recession in the second year of his first term.*
